description: Defines the interface classes for HPACK entry decoder listeners used in HTTP/2 header decoding, including base, logging, and no-op implementations.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoderListener
classes.description: Abstract base class for HPACK entry decoder event listeners.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoderVLoggingListener
classes.description: A listener that logs events before delegating to another listener.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoderNoOpListener
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the listener interface.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Called when an indexed header is decoded.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Called when a literal header with optional name is decoded.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Called when the start of a header name is decoded.

methods.name: OnNameData
methods.description: Called when a portion of the header name data is decoded.

methods.name: OnNameEnd
methods.description: Called after the entire header name has been decoded.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Called when the start of a header value is decoded.

methods.name: OnValueData
methods.description: Called when a portion of the header value data is decoded.

methods.name: OnValueEnd
methods.description: Called after the entire header value has been decoded.

methods.name: OnDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Called when the dynamic table size update is decoded.
